<thought>Based on the observed isotopic peak series (spacing ~1 Da, decreasing intensities 100 → 11 → 0.5 → 0.016 → ...), the pattern matches the natural 13C isotopic distribution of carbon. No characteristic Cl, Br, S, etc., patterns are present, so carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
